scripts.native:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/configureNativeProjects.ts
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && cap open android
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && cap open ios
scripts.native:android:debug: npm run native:sync && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/buildNative.ts android
scripts.native:ios:simulator: npm run native:sync && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/buildNative.ts ios
scripts.typecheck:edge: deno check --config supabase/functions/google-calendar/deno.json --frozen supabase/functions/google-calendar/index.ts && deno check --config supabase/functions/google-calendar-callback/deno.json --frozen supabase/functions/google-calendar-callback/index.ts && deno check --config supabase/functions/dictionary-lookup/deno.json supabase/functions/dictionary-lookup/index.ts && deno check --config supabase/functions/google-translation/deno.json supabase/functions/google-translation/index.ts
scripts.test:pwa: npm run build && playwright test e2e/offlineApp.spec.ts e2e/installableApp.spec.ts
scripts.test:native: npm run build:native && playwright test --config playwright.native.config.ts
